verses.en: I love that the LORD should hear Mmy voice and my supplications.
Because He hath inclined His ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon Him all my days.

verses.he: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי׀ חֶבְלֵי־מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃
verses.en: The cords of death compassed me, And the straits of the nether-world got hold upon me; I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.he: וּבְשֵֽׁם־יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: But I called upon the name of the LORD: 'I beseech thee, O LORD, deliver my soul.'
Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; Yea, our God is compassionate.

verses.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.en: The LORD preserveth the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.

verses.he: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי־יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃
verses.en: Return, O my soul, unto Thy rest; For the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

verses.he: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת־עֵינִ֥י מִן־דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת־רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃
verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, And my feet from stumbling.
I shall walk before the LORD In the lands of the living.

verses.he: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: I trusted even when I spoke: 'I am greatly afflicted.'
I said in my haste: 'All men are liars.'
How can I repay unto the LORD All His bountiful dealings toward me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the LORD.
My vows will I pay unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people.
Precious in the sight of the LORD Is the death of His saints.

verses.he: אָֽנָּ֣ה יְהוָה֮ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֪י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲ‍ֽנִי־עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָֽי׃
verses.en: I beseech Thee, O LORD, for I am Thy servant; I am Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bands.

verses.he: לְֽךָ־אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the LORD.
I will pay my vows unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people;

verses.he: בְּחַצְר֤וֹת׀ בֵּ֤ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽת֘וֹכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלָ‍ִ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: In the courts of the LORD’S house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah.
